lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape hee prabh dehi mat har naam dhiaaeeai ||
lines.translation: God Himself bestows wisdom; meditate on the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadabhaagee satigur milai mukh a(n)mrit paaeeai ||
lines.translation: By great good fortune, one meets the True Guru, who places the Ambrosial Nectar in the mouth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai dubidhaa binas jaai sahaje sukh samaaeeai ||
lines.translation: When egotism and duality are eradicated, one intuitively merges in peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਨਾਇ ਲਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sabh aape aap varatadaa aape naai laaeeai ||2||
lines.translation: He Himself is All-pervading; He Himself links us to His Name. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਗਰਬਿ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਇਆਣੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh garab na paaio agiaan iaane ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs, in their arrogant pride, do not find God; they are so ignorant and foolish!

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਣੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sevaa naa karahi phir phir pachhutaane ||
lines.translation: They do not serve the True Guru, and in the end, they regret and repent, over and over again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨੀ ਵਾਸੁ ਪਾਇਦੇ ਗਰਭੇ ਗਲਿ ਜਾਣੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: garabh jonee vaas paaide garabhe gal jaane ||
lines.translation: They are cast into the womb to be reincarnated, and within the womb, they rot.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਕਰਤੇ ਏਵੈ ਭਾਵਦਾ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮਾਣੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: mere karate evai bhaavadaa manamukh bharamaane ||3||
lines.translation: As it pleases my Creator Lord, the self-willed manmukhs wander around lost. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਇਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: merai har prabh lekh likhaaiaa dhur masatak pooraa ||
lines.translation: My Lord God inscribed the full pre-ordained destiny upon the forehead.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੂਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam dhiaaiaa bhetiaa gur sooraa ||
lines.translation: When one meets the Great and Courageous Guru, one meditates on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਬੰਧਪੁ ਬੀਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: meraa pitaa maataa har naam hai har ba(n)dhap beeraa ||
lines.translation: The Lord's Name is my mother and father; the Lord is my relative and brother.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕੀਰਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੭॥੩੭॥
lines.transliteration: har har bakhas milaai prabh jan naanak keeraa ||4||3||17||37||
lines.translation: O Lord, Har, Har, please forgive me and unite me with Yourself. Servant Nanak is a lowly worm. ||4||3||17||37||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee bairaagan mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Gauree Bairaagan, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur te giaan paaiaa har tat beechaaraa ||
lines.translation: From the True Guru, I obtained spiritual wisdom; I contemplate the Lord's essence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਤਿ ਮਲੀਣ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਭਈ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: mat maleen paragat bhaee jap naam muraaraa ||
lines.translation: My polluted intellect was enlightened by chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਵਿ ਸਕਤਿ ਮਿਟਾਈਆ ਚੂਕਾ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: siv sakat mitaaeeaa chookaa a(n)dhiaaraa ||
lines.translation: The distinction between Shiva and Shakti - mind and matter - has been destroyed, and the darkness has been dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: dhur masatak jin kau likhiaa tin har naam piaaraa ||1||
lines.translation: The Lord's Name is loved by those, upon whose foreheads such pre-ordained destiny was written. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਹੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kit bidh paaeeai sa(n)t janahu jis dekh hau jeevaa ||
lines.translation: How can the Lord be obtained, O Saints? Seeing Him, my life is sustained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਚਸਾ ਨ ਜੀਵਤੀ ਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਿਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har bin chasaa na jeevatee gur melihu har ras peevaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Without the Lord, I cannot live, even for an instant. Unite me with the Guru, so that I may drink in the sublime essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਤਿ ਕੀਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau har gun gaavaa nit har sunee har har gat keenee ||
lines.translation: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and I listen to them daily; the Lord, Har, Har, has emancipated me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਲੀਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ras gur te paaiaa meraa man tan leenee ||
lines.translation: I have obtained the Lord's essence from the Guru; my mind and body are drenched with it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan dhan gur sat purakh hai jin bhagat har deenee ||
lines.translation: Blessed, blessed is the Guru, the True Being, who has blessed me with devotional worship of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਹਮ ਕੀਨੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jis gur te har paaiaa so gur ham keenee ||2||
lines.translation: From the Guru, I have obtained the Lord; I have made Him my Guru. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ਹੈ ਹਮ ਅਵਗਣਿਆਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gunadaataa har raai hai ham avaganiaare ||
lines.translation: The Sovereign Lord is the Giver of virtue. I am worthless and without virtue.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਪੀ ਪਾਥਰ ਡੂਬਦੇ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: paapee paathar doobade guramat har taare ||
lines.translation: The sinners sink like stones; through the Guru's Teachings, the Lord carries us across.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਹਮ ਅਵਗਣਿਆਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) gunadaataa niramalaa ham avaganiaare ||
lines.translation: You are the Giver of virtue, O Immaculate Lord; I am worthless and without virtue.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: har saranaagat raakh lehu mooR mugadh nisataare ||3||
lines.translation: I have entered Your Sanctuary, Lord; please save me, as You have saved the idiots and fools. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahaj ana(n)d sadaa guramatee har har man dhiaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Eternal celestial bliss comes through the Guru's Teachings, by meditating continually on the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਜਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਘਰਿ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sajan har prabh paaiaa ghar sohilaa gaaiaa ||
lines.translation: I have obtained the Lord God as my Best Friend, within the home of my own self. I sing the Songs of Joy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har daiaa dhaar prabh benatee har har chetaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Please shower me with Your Mercy, O Lord God, that I may meditate on Your Name, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਧੂੜਿ ਤਿਨ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੮॥੩੮॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak ma(n)gai dhooR tin jin satigur paaiaa ||4||4||18||38||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak begs for the dust of the feet of those who have found the True Guru. ||4||4||18||38||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਚਉਥਾ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 4 chauthaa chaupade ||
lines.translation: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fourth Mehl, Chau-Padhay:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਸਾਸਤ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪੜਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)dit saasat simrit paRiaa ||
lines.translation: The Pandit - the religious scholar - recites the Shaastras and the Simritees;

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਗੋਰਖੁ ਗੋਰਖੁ ਕਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jogee gorakh gorakh kariaa ||
lines.translation: the Yogi cries out, "Gorakh, Gorakh".

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਪੜਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: mai moorakh har har jap paRiaa ||1||
lines.translation: But I am just a fool - I just chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਜਾਨਾ ਕਿਆ ਗਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa jaanaa kiaa gat raam hamaaree ||
lines.translation: I do not know what my condition shall be, Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤਰੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤੂ ਤਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har bhaj man mere tar bhaujal too taaree ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: O my mind, vibrate and meditate on the Name of the Lord. You shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||
